name: buildkite
description: Connect Buildkite to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Buildkite MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Buildkite to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with cI pipelines and builds using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Buildkite workspace.
Find anything in Buildkite that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review cI pipelines and builds in Buildkite.
